episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Dr. Oliver Wolf reluctantly accepts a job at Bronx General Hospital where he's forced to work with a team of interns as they treat a mother who can no longer recognize her kids.

episodes.title: The Disembodied Woman
episodes.summary: When a high school girls' basketball coach is faced with a debilitating illness, Dr. Wolf must help his patient reconnect with her body before it's too late. Ericka and Dana treat a frat boy who sees dragons.

episodes.title: The Lost Biker
episodes.summary: A member of a biker gang seeks out Dr. Wolf's help as he grapples with life-threatening memory loss. The interns are tasked to help a young girl struggling with mysterious seizures.

episodes.title: The Blackout Bride
episodes.summary: When a bloody bride stumbles into Bronx General, Wolf goes to extreme measures in a race against the clock to save her and her missing husband. Ericka and Jacob must find a reason for their John Doe patient not to get transferred out of their care.

episodes.title: The Haunted Marine
episodes.summary: Wolf must help a Marine grapple with mysterious symptoms before the birth of his child.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Cried Pregnant
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf and the interns go back to high school to treat a group of pregnant teenagers.

episodes.title: The Man from Grozny
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf and the team perform their most experimental treatment yet: a brain computer interface implantation in their John Doe patient's brain.

episodes.title: The Lovesick Widow
episodes.summary: When an elderly woman is brought in with signs of dementia, Dr. Wolf investigates whether she's suffering from a neurological disorder or having a late-in-life awakening. Dr. Pierce grapples with a chilling discovery about one of her patients.

episodes.title: The Colorblind Painter
episodes.summary: When an artist refuses to paint for his upcoming show, Dr. Wolf and his team must figure out why. Dr. Pierce goes into uncharted territory with a patient.

episodes.title: The First Responder
episodes.summary: An unexpected patient crashes into Bronx General with mysterious life-threatening symptoms.

episodes.title: The Other Woman
episodes.summary: Dr. Pierce treats a patient in crisis, presenting an ethical dilemma. Dr. Wolf and Dr. Nichols disagree on how to treat a patient.

episodes.title: The Doctor Whose World Collapsed
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf and his team face their biggest challenge yet when an apartment building collapses in the Bronx.

episodes.title: The Man Who Can't See Faces
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf meets a pastor dealing with mysterious visions. The interns grapple with the fallout from the building collapse.

episodes.title: The Phantom Hook
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf helps an MMA fighter with mysterious symptoms; Dr. Pierce considers a career outside of Bronx General.

episodes.title: The Contestant
episodes.summary: A reality show contestant lands at the hospital with an unusual delusion; Dr. Pierce fights for her future at Bronx General.

episodes.title: The Pusher
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf and his team treat a young patient accused of a serious crime.

episodes.title: Lady Liberty
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf and Dr. Pierce are tasked with a house call to evaluate a woman under a conservatorship.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time in America
episodes.summary: When two patients arrive in critical condition, Dr. Wolf and Dr. Nichols must do whatever it takes to keep them alive.

episodes.title: The Doctor's Graveyard
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf is haunted by a ghost from his past; a patient arrives at Bronx General who appears to have risen from the dead.

episodes.title: The One That Got Away
episodes.summary: A blast from the past shakes up Dr. Wolf's world when he becomes his next patient.

episodes.title: The Upside Down
episodes.summary: On a flight gone wrong, one patient's life is quite literally turned upside down.

episodes.title: The Fire Fighter
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf helps a fire fighter and his family navigate a life-changing diagnosis on Thanksgiving.

episodes.title: The Resident
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf helps a ballerina recover after a mystery illness; the team tries to save Sam's life and get him on the transplant list; secrets are revealed at the hospital's annual holiday gala that change the course of the doctors' lives.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Feels Everything
episodes.summary: Dr. Wolf and the team come together as one of their own fights for their life.

episodes.title: The Rider
episodes.summary: A rugged cowboy struts into Bronx General with mysterious symptoms and brings the rodeo with him. Dr. Wolf develops a relationship with someone who has ties to his father.

episodes.title: The Rabbit Hole
episodes.summary: When a college student comes in with a life-threatening illness, Dr. Wolf and his team have to get acquainted with sorority life. Dr. Thorne treats a child who collapsed under mysterious circumstances.

episodes.title: The Invisible Man
episodes.summary: A grisly accident puts everyone at Bronx General in danger and leads to a shocking revelation about Dr. Wolf.

episodes.title: The Missing Person
episodes.summary: A Party Girl, who's on the run, is rushed into the hospital and our doctors have to figure out what exactly she's running from. When Wolf doesn't show up for his shift at the hospital, Carol-- worried about his mental health-- goes on a mission to find him.

episodes.title: Senses
episodes.summary: Wolf grapples with being a psych patient at Hudson Oaks and has a startling revelation. A renowned chef comes into Bronx General after a harrowing accident at his restaurant.

episodes.title: Doctor, Interrupted
episodes.summary: Wolf becomes fascinated with an unusual patient at Hudson Oaks, who displays signs of being possessed. Carol and Thorne help newlyweds who are struggling with their sex life.

episodes.title: Through the Looking Glass
episodes.summary: On his first day back at Bronx General, Wolf treats an ex-con who has a medical emergency during a hostage situation. Ericka and Charlie care for a newborn baby in the midst of a life-threatening illness.

episodes.title: The Hero's Journey
episodes.summary: Wolf treats an anxious teen boy who's faced with a terrifying procedure: awake brain surgery. Carol and Dana investigate possible corruption at Hudson Oaks.

episodes.title: The Way Home
episodes.summary: Wolf and Josh's relationship is tested when they tackle a case that hits close to home. Carol and Thorne deal with a patient harboring a huge secret. Van returns and helps Ericka and Dana through their own personal crises.
